title: migration-report.json
description: The report of a migration to 31: the old and new versions, the hand edits made, the notices that need no edit, the choices the package was migrated with, how many differences are explained, and each compared text. Reported, never a gate; like the other derived files it never lives in source.

handEdits.description: The hand edits made; [] for none.

notices.description: Every notice that needs no edit: a renamed id, a _macro suffix, a !x converted to blank(x), a suggestion, a reproducible claim that differed, the worst-case note; [] for none.

renames.description: Each hand-chosen rename, a 30 id to its 31 id; {} for none.

whenEmpty.description: Each deliverable's hand-chosen whenEmpty, by its id; {} for none (every deliverable release).

folderFormats.description: The format a snippet folder's items take, by the folder's id; {} for none (each folder <folder>_item).

options.description: The choices the package was migrated with: its options.json, beside its hand edits, as the migration read it.

explained.description: The texts that differ whose difference the rules explain whole: expected.

partlyExplained.description: The texts that differ with a rule credited and a remainder no rule explains.

unexplained.description: The texts that differ with no rule credited.

counts.description: Of the texts that differ, how many the rules explain whole, in part and not at all; an equal text is in none.

site.description: The compared text's site: the file and place in it.

oldHash.description: The hash of the text at 30.

newHash.description: The hash of the text at 31.

equal.description: Whether the two texts are equal.

expected.description: Whether the rewrite declares and explains the whole difference: a rule is credited and nothing is unexplained.

explanation.description: Why the difference is expected; null unless expected is true.

rules.description: The ids of the rules credited with part or all of the difference, in the comparison's order; [] for none and for an equal text.

unexplained.description: Whether a difference no rule explains is left; false for an equal text.

texts.description: One entry per compared text; [] for none.
